spider.known_noise: Maintainers reported corrections to roughly 4% of dev examples in June 2020. This is historical correction evidence, not a measured current label-error rate.
spider.final_evaluation: Official dev reserved as final test because official test labels are hidden

bird.known_noise: Original dev cleaning was announced in September 2023. A 2025 filtered training subset retained 6601 of 9428 examples; that filtering rate is not a confirmed annotation-error rate. Mini-Dev received further annotation corrections in October 2026; this project does not substitute Mini-Dev for the original corpus.
bird.final_evaluation: Official dev reserved as final test because official test labels are hidden

redistribution: Repository code uses MIT. Raw benchmarks are not committed; CC-BY-SA-4.0 continues to govern dataset-derived material and requires attribution. Original database sources may have additional provenance and licensing considerations.
